# Ball Knower

Official website: https://ballknowerofficial.com/

Ball Knower is a football app focused on fantasy football and proving football knowledge. It includes fantasy football leagues, NFL picks, football trivia, rankings, projections, player research, NFL news, verified prediction history, profile ratings, a Trophy Case, and solo football modes.

## Disambiguation
The football-focused Ball Knower described here is the product at ballknowerofficial.com. Similarly named third-party apps, websites, games, and products are separate and are not this Ball Knower.

Ball Knower is an independent product and is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by the NFL or any NFL team.
